sections.en: 8 φοσάτου ('of the camp') the codex has. 10 κημία ('alchemy') from the Arabic Kīmīa for the Greek χυμεία ('alchemy'). 16 περὶ σχηματισμῶν Ἄρεως καὶ Σελήνης ('concerning the configurations of Mars and the Moon') I have inserted. 18 πολλύ ('much') the codex has. 23 ἔρις ('strife') the codex has. 25 οὐχ’ ('not') the codex has. 31 περὶ συνόδου Ἡλίου καὶ Ἑρμοῦ ('concerning the conjunction of the Sun and Mercury') I have inserted.

summary.headline: Planetary Configuration Omens
summary.text: Astrological omens from planetary configurations describe war, mortality, political disorder, weather, alchemy, and social conditions. Separate sections treat Mars with the Moon, the Sun with Venus in Kochstan among the Turks, and the Sun with Mercury.
